shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if test -f /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/d5ee4b4d7833/workspace/round-brief.md; then sed -n '1,240p' /var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/d5ee4b4d7833/workspace/round-brief.md; else echo 'NO ROUND BRIEF'; fi
printf '\\n--- DOD ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
printf '\\n--- package scripts ---\\n'
node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\"
printf '\\n--- orchestration files ---\\n'
rg --files src/orchestration specs .lore | sort
printf '\\n--- current orchestrator usage ---\\n'
rg -n -C 5 'Usage|usage|afterModelResponse|lastUsage|totalUsage' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator*.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG* 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts
printf '\\n--- aggregate test ---\\n'
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorAggregateUsage.test.ts
printf '\\n--- ai types ---\\n'
rg -n -C 8 'UsageMetadata|AggregatedUsageMetadata' src/types/ai.ts
printf '\\n--- no-tool test context ---\\n'
sed -n '225,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
printf '\\n--- spec hooks relevant ---\\n'
rg -n -C 5 'usage|afterModelResponse|tool round|under-count' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
printf '\\n--- test command manifest ---\\n'
sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,90p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '180,225p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,80p' src/types/ai.ts
sed -n '1,20p' CHANGELOG.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat && git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/types/ai.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorAggregateUsage.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,320p'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t 'keeps a no-tool turn usage unchanged'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/index.ts src/types/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/types/ai.ts
if test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; else echo 'no scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs'; fi"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat
git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts src/index.ts src/types/index.ts CHANGELOG.md | sed -n '1,320p'
printf '\\n--- anchor lines ---\\n'
rg -n 'reports the summed|counts reported|keeps a no-tool|afterModelResponse.*summed|no tool calls' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t 'keeps a no-tool turn usage unchanged'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/index.ts src/types/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorAggregateUsage.test.ts && git commit -m "test: preserve no-tool usage contract" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
